_what: The speaker's own rulings on what was said, applied after reconciliation.
_why: reconcile.py keeps the SPOKEN words wherever the recording departs from the script, which is right - an adlib must survive. But where the SCRIPT ITSELF was transcribed from the recogniser, both sources carry the same error and reconciliation has nothing to correct against. A recogniser cannot tell 'with an' from 'within'; only the speaker can.
_floor: Every correction must match exactly once. A previous hand-keyed correction list was removed from this pipeline because it could not survive a non-deterministic recogniser; that objection was sound, and the answer is not to omit the list but to make a miss FAIL loudly instead of passing silently.

corrections.why: the essay's phrase and the speaker's word; 'with an' and 'within' are acoustically all but identical, so the recogniser's reading is not evidence either way
